header.description: Download the CASS-sorted postal manifest ready for printer injection (Action Mail / Inland Valley) and manage dynamic QR codes with redirects and real-time analytics.

printer.label: Delivery to printer
printer.body: Download the CSV and send it to Action Mail / Inland Valley. Once they have it, stamp the delivery: section 4 opens and the campaign moves into production.
printer.needDownload: Run the curation and download the manifest before stamping.

routeManifest.title: Route Manifest (EDDM)
routeManifest.description: This is the operative file. It carries the carrier routes bought, their codes and how many pieces go to each. It is all the printer and the post office need: the carrier already knows which boxes are on the route.
routeManifest.noRoutes: No routes selected yet. Run the route engine in the previous section.

profile.title: Neighbourhood profile
profile.description: This is your evidence for the sale, not a postal file. It comes from the Riverside County parcel roll — public record — and describes the housing on the routes you bought. Show it to the advertiser: they can check it parcel by parcel.
profile.noRoutes: Select routes first: with no routes there is no neighbourhood to describe.
profile.unavailable: The county did not answer. Better no figure than an invented one: try again later.
profile.footnote: The drop is {{households}} boxes across {{routes}} routes, per USPS: that is the number printed and billed. The ratios above were measured over {{sampled}} parcels from the roll (year built available for {{coverage}} of them). Source: {{source}}.
